answer: The desk only stamps a name that carries Carvebound silver fan warden palm seal, and the stamp itself rests on a seal silver fan wardens renew after fan workroom hearings. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Nobody is waved through free: 25 separate visits, each one billed £49 at the door is the price, and the thread never covers it twice. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Every garden is counted once. One anchor, one entry.
